<div class="card-body">
'''Hydroponics Station''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">水耕ステーション</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、タトゥイーンの屋外の位置に配備する。フォースを起動する際、最初の１枚を直接手札にすることができる。場にヴァーポレーターがあれば、２枚目も手札に加えることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-37o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">非常に効率よく水を使い、野菜や果物を栽培する。地下式の場合もある。栽培したものは食用にするが、余ったら市場で売られることもある。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hydroponics Station.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy at an exterior location on Tatooine. When activating Force, you may take the first card directly into hand. If a Vaporator is on table, you may take the second card into hand as well.

'''Lore:''' Uses water very efficiently to grow vegetables and fruit. Some stations are underground. The produce is grown for food, with any surplus sometimes sold at market.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hydroponics Station]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
